using the angle upright without the fitted metal roll-compensation spacers and taper head seats
using printed polymer in the bike-connector primary load path
tightening a cross-bolt across an empty hollow tube
forcing an oversize plug into the measured rail

sequence: cut two 45 mm primary angles and two 45 mm outer-cheek source segments from the ordered 1.5 x 1.5 x 0.125 inch 6063-T6 angle
trim each primary-angle base leg to 29 mm; cut and trim each outer cheek to 45 x 25 x 3.175 mm
install each primary angle on the inside/front face of the backplate with three flush M5 flat-head through-bolts, rear washers, and nylocs
fit and label each 14.7 mm nominal solid plug in its measured rail
compound-cut and finish each matched rail/plug pair together until the full bearing face seats on its primary-angle base
hand-fit the two metal tapered spacers per rail, clamp the primary-angle/spacer/rail/plug/outer-cheek stack, and transfer-drill both lower M5 paths
install the four M5 x 40 lower through-bolts with metal taper seats, washers, and nylocs
offer the metal/backplate/rail assembly through the open rear service aperture
seat the rail upper ends in the unchanged 21 mm V6.1 sockets
install the two upper M4 socket cross-bolts
install the six rear-loaded M5 backplate-to-shell fasteners
install the open rear bezel only after all structural fasteners are torqued and witnessed
